title: Reduce Combines a List into One Value

contentBlocks.body: reduce walks an array and folds it into a single value. The callback receives the running accumulator and the current item, and the second argument to reduce is the starting accumulator.

contentBlocks.code:
const total = [10, 20, 5].reduce((sum, value) => sum + value, 0);
// total is 35

knowledgeItems.prompt: What is the second argument passed to reduce?

payload.explanation: reduce(callback, initialValue) seeds the accumulator with initialValue.

knowledgeItems.prompt: Return the total of every XP value using reduce (0 for an empty list).
